name: Recursive Control Variate Gradient Estimator
definition: A gradient estimator for inverse rendering that combines Path Replay Backpropagation (PRB) for the rendering derivative and a recursive control variate (CV) for the primal image estimate to reduce variance and bias in non-L2 loss optimization.
summary: The Recursive Control Variate Gradient Estimator reduces variance and bias in differentiable volume rendering by combining Path Replay Backpropagation with recursive control variates that reuse previous iteration statistics.
